scenarios.inputs: Verified fresh member; client-only role assertion, foreign guild evidence, expired observation and unavailable source.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Permit only the verified case. Other cases create no protected output or durable effects.

scenarios.inputs: Owned, unknown and foreign synthetic selectors across route, bot, socket, asset, receipt, cache and room boundaries.
scenarios.requiredObservations: An authorized scoped case succeeds. Unknown and foreign outcomes match publicly. No foreign lookup effect, join, write or delivery.

scenarios.inputs: One valid synthetic redemption; missing, expired, rebound and duplicate transaction outcomes; expired or revoked session.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Exactly one valid session. Renewal replaces old authority. Diagnostics, URL, bundle and export contain no sensitive sentinel.

scenarios.inputs: Allowed and unapproved ingress classifications; valid origin with missing session; untrusted forwarded metadata.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Only validated session and allowed ingress reach policy. Untrusted forwarding conveys no authority. Verify real Discord client matrix separately.

scenarios.inputs: Stage an admitted intent. Order valid commit and invalidation both ways. Separately order invalidation then regrant before old intent reaches commit.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Only valid commit-first accepts, with one state change, revision, receipt and outbox. Stale regrant case has no committed effects.

scenarios.inputs: Preparation succeeds. At commit, independently supply missing or stale policy, membership or trusted time, or unavailable fence/audit.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Every case fails closed with no committed content, revision, receipt or accepted outbox. Bounded denial telemetry only.

scenarios.inputs: Enumerated permitted transition and denied self approval, self escalation, moderator escalation, unknown action and write under lockdown.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Allow only valid capability. Accepted change advances generation and records scoped audit. Denial changes neither board nor permission.

scenarios.inputs: Inert synthetic text plus abstract content classifications: unsupported type, active content, mismatched type and expanded size over budget.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Supported inert content renders safely. Rejections publish no file or metadata. Demonstrate scoped SQL, opaque storage paths and no arbitrary fetch capability.

scenarios.inputs: Cross current read-denial reason with absent, matching and mismatching synthetic receipt state.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Current read denial causes zero receipt/digest reads, no protected output, no durable effects and no unknown outcome settlement. Compare normalized public outcomes.

scenarios.inputs: Readable historical matching receipt with write denied; historical digest mismatch; retired intent with absent receipt.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Match settles historical operation only, mismatch returns fenced IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, absent returns fenced LINEAGE_CHANGED. No write. Active save state requires authorized rejoin/resync.

scenarios.inputs: Run both authority/release orders for each protected output kind, including backpressured chunks. Vary session revocation/expiry, stale membership, read policy and unavailable time/fence.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Valid release-first may complete. Authority loss first suppresses prepared output and following queued chunks. Denied ACK preserves durable accepted state and leaves client outcome unknown.

scenarios.inputs: Valid board/asset metadata and chunk release, then a denied included asset or authority change while chunks are queued. Include a storage boundary without fencing.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Every release requires board and each included asset authorization. No affected metadata/chunk escapes on denial or direct storage bypass.

scenarios.inputs: Parallel identical intent, changed digest, rollback and simulated lost ACK or ambiguous commit status.
scenarios.requiredObservations: One accepted commit per identity, no rollback effects. Same identity reconciles under current read/release checks. Unknown remains unresolved without evidence.

scenarios.inputs: Use approved finite budgets at below/at/above boundaries. Simulate queue pressure and full quota in one synthetic tenant.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Excess work remains bounded and isolated. Accepted durable events survive slow consumer closure and resync.

scenarios.inputs: Review approved service inventory, dependency drift and credential exposure classes.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Unapproved exposure or missing dated test evidence blocks release. Real authorized GoDaddy observations, renewal, WSS and rollback remain required.

scenarios.inputs: Apply a fenced deletion, interrupt propagation, retry, and restore a synthetic prior copy with incomplete deletion-marker reconciliation.
scenarios.requiredObservations: No stale delivery or resurrection. Live and backup/hold milestones remain distinct. Incomplete restore stays isolated.

scenarios.inputs: Compare permitted append, denied moderator read/write, altered/truncated synthetic record history and redaction sentinels.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Only scoped rights succeed. Independent checkpoints flag alteration and truncation. Sensitive sentinel absent from audit, diagnostics and exported evidence.

scenarios.inputs: Evidence for exact candidate, stale candidate, missing real environment, fixture-only review, and expired exception.
scenarios.requiredObservations: Only complete eligible evidence passes. Stale, missing or ineligible evidence and unresolved critical/high findings without accepted disposition block release.
